features.title: Blog
features.tldr: Markdown post folders become per-post HTML, an index and an RSS feed at build time; project heads are prerendered; the Blog link shows once a post is published.
features.summary: build-blog.mjs runs after vite build; blog-posts.mjs is the one decider of a published post and of the post order; /blog lists every published post in every locale with a language tag and tag filter, /blog/:slug shows the body the build rendered; the root head carries the default share image and the feed link.

features.title: Content contract
features.tldr: projects.ts is the one project schema, one regex per URL or email field, site-content.schema.json its 2020-12 export; verify checks locales and assets.
features.summary: The site's content JSON has one machine contract built on the one project schema that declares every top-level key; verify's unit tests parse the three locale files against it with nothing stripped, keep the published JSON Schema equal to a fresh export and mappable by the panel's Studio, and hold every rule on the files under public/assets.

features.title: Deploy infrastructure
features.tldr: One Terraform module serves the site from private S3 via CloudFront per env; Actions deploys over OIDC, hashed assets immutable, the rest no-cache.
features.summary: terraform/modules/portfolio-static-site is the one topology, called by envs/stage and envs/prod, and names each env's bucket and distribution in SSM for the panel; the terraform workflow is a manual apply per env on the panel's infra role; the deploy workflow uploads the published schema, syncs dist/ under one cache rule, uploads each prerendered route as an extensionless HTML object and invalidates CloudFront; a one-time script creates only the OIDC provider.

features.title: Legacy specs
features.tldr: specs-bkp/ is the pre-canon specs tree kept by specs init; it is reading material only, unread by the site and its gates.
features.summary: specs-bkp/ holds the specs tree as it stood before the current specs/ canon, the input the first-pass audit reads to fill memory. No build, test, workflow or runtime path reads it.

features.title: Scene media pipeline and player
features.tldr: Scenes recorded from a pinned PyPI version, hash-named under byte budgets, played muted and looped, a still under reduced motion.
features.summary: A developer tool in frontend/media turns a pinned package's real terminal output into hash-named webm, mp4 and poster cuts, and publishes SVG scene pairs; the Media component plays them in view, picks the cut by width and shows the still when motion is reduced.

features.title: dadaia-workspace project page
features.tldr: The dadaia-workspace library page - version held once in pypi.version, tag v plus it; a hero loop, three scenes, a Try it and facts from the tag.
features.summary: The projectsV2 item slug dadaia-workspace, kind library, in the three locale content files; every claim on it states what the pinned PyPI release ships and links its source at the pinned git tag.

features.title: Library project page layout
features.tldr: The one library page layout - purpose, install line, hero media, scenes, Try it, Why it exists, facts at a tag; versions filled from pypi.version.
features.summary: LibraryProjectTemplate renders a library item in a fixed order from its content alone, filling the {version} and {tag} placeholders from pypi.version; scene sections sit text beside their media on wide screens, and the facts heading names the library and its pinned version.

features.title: rand-engine project page
features.tldr: The rand-engine library page - version held once in pypi.version, tag equal to it; a hero loop, three scenes, a runnable Try it and tag-sourced facts.
features.summary: The projectsV2 item slug rand-engine, kind library, in the three locale content files; its scenes, example and facts state what the pinned PyPI release ships, each fact linked to its source at the pinned git tag.

features.title: End-to-end suite
features.tldr: Playwright runs nine smoke specs on every PR and the full suite weekly, against a local server on port 8080 with the pt-BR locale.
features.summary: playwright.config.ts picks the smoke set under E2E_SMOKE, else every spec under tests/e2e; CI runs Chromium against vite preview of the built dist, locally five browser projects against the dev server.

features.title: Resume home
features.tldr: The home is a frameless resume - hero, experience, two projects, skills, certifications, education - numbers derived from content, labels from the locale.
features.summary: Portfolio renders Hero, Experience, Projects, Skills, Certifications and Education in one column with no section card or fold; the hero's stat line is derived from content, role periods are localized by one parser, and the only disclosures are the story toggle and each role's Details control.

features.title: Shared site chrome
features.tldr: One header and one footer on every route, one 960 px column with 680 px prose, one type scale, localized chrome strings and <html lang>.
features.summary: A layout route renders the one header, the one main landmark in the site's 960 px column and the one footer for every page; the project routes add a breadcrumb and back link; chrome text, theme first paint and the document language follow the visitor's locale and stored theme.
